primary_title: The mouse SLIT family: secreted ligands for ROBO expressed in patterns that suggest a role in morphogenesis and axon guidance
decision_basis: The review-guided candidate is the vertebrate Slit-Robo1 axon-guidance edge; the cited primary mouse study demonstrates Slit1 protein binding to Robo1 and complementary developmental expression consistent with a ligand-receptor relationship.
limitations_preserved: Promote the exact mouse Slit1-Robo1 binding/axon-guidance context; do not infer a defined intracellular Robo relay or SCI receiver-state claim.
